name: io.github.cyanheads/stackexchange-mcp-server
description: Search Stack Exchange questions, fetch Q&A threads as markdown, look up tag FAQs and user profiles.

tools.name: stackexchange_list_sites
tools.description: Discover Stack Exchange communities by name, apiSiteParameter, or audience. Returns site type and URL. The apiSiteParameter value is what other tools accept as the `site` input (e.g. "stackoverflow", "superuser", "serverfault"). Results are fetched live. Include the standalone "meta" filter token to include meta sites. Use this tool to discover valid site parameters before calling other stackexchange_* tools.

filter.description: Case-insensitive filter. Every token must match the site name, apiSiteParameter, or audience. Include the standalone token "meta" to include meta sites, or pass "meta" alone to browse the complete catalog.

tools.name: stackexchange_search_questions
tools.description: Search questions across a Stack Exchange site. Returns ranked questions with title, score, answer count, accepted status, tags, ask and last-activity dates, and a short excerpt of the question body — not the full body. Results supply question_id values for stackexchange_get_thread, which fetches the full question body and all answers. Results past the pageSize cap are reachable with the `page` parameter. Use the `site` parameter to target a specific community (e.g. "stackoverflow", "superuser", "unix"); call stackexchange_list_sites to discover valid site values.

query.description: Full-text search query (e.g. "python async generator send value"). Pass an empty string to browse with the selected sort and filters.

site.description: Stack Exchange site to search — the apiSiteParameter (e.g. "stackoverflow", "superuser", "serverfault") or the site's domain (e.g. "serverfault.com"). Blank or omitted defaults to "stackoverflow". Call stackexchange_list_sites to discover valid values.

tags.description: Filter results by tag. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed and blank entries are ignored.

items.description: A single tag to filter by (e.g. "python", "async").

acceptedOnly.description: When true, return only questions that have an accepted answer.

minScore.description: Minimum question score — excludes questions with lower scores. Setting minScore orders results by score (votes), which may differ from the requested sort.

sort.description: Result ordering: "relevance" (default, best match), "votes" (highest score first), "activity" (most recently active), "newest" (most recently created).

pageSize.description: Number of results to return (1–30, default 10).

page.description: Page of results to return, 1-based (default 1). Page 2 with pageSize 10 returns results 11–20. Each page is a separate upstream call and costs one API quota unit, which matters on the keyless 300/day tier. Without STACKEXCHANGE_API_KEY, Stack Exchange refuses any page above 25.

tools.name: stackexchange_get_tag_faq
tools.description: Fetch the frequently asked questions for a tag on a Stack Exchange site — Stack Exchange's own "frequently asked" selection, returned in its order, not ranked by score; compare the scores yourself. Returns a question list without bodies; use stackexchange_get_thread to read the full body and answers for any result. Results past the pageSize cap are reachable with the `page` parameter. Use this tool to find the questions a community keeps coming back to on a topic (e.g. tag "javascript" on stackoverflow). Use stackexchange_search_questions for free-text search rather than tag-based browsing.

tag.description: Tag to look up (e.g. "python", "javascript", "docker"). Must match exactly after trimming surrounding whitespace.

site.description: Stack Exchange site — the apiSiteParameter (e.g. "stackoverflow", "superuser") or the site's domain (e.g. "superuser.com"). Blank or omitted defaults to "stackoverflow". Call stackexchange_list_sites to discover valid values.

pageSize.description: Number of results to return (1–30, default 10).

page.description: Page of results to return, 1-based (default 1). Page 2 with pageSize 10 returns results 11–20. Each page is a separate upstream call and costs one API quota unit, which matters on the keyless 300/day tier. Without STACKEXCHANGE_API_KEY, Stack Exchange refuses any page above 25.

tools.name: stackexchange_get_user
tools.description: Fetch a Stack Exchange user profile by numeric user ID: reputation, badge counts, answer and question counts, account and last-access dates, and top tags by answer score. Useful for credibility context on an answer author — pass the authorUserId from any question or answer in stackexchange_get_thread output. Returns profile fields plus up to 10 top tags by answer score.

userId.description: Numeric user ID (at most 2147483647) — use the authorUserId field from a question or answer in stackexchange_get_thread output.

site.description: Stack Exchange site the user ID belongs to — the apiSiteParameter (e.g. "stackoverflow", "superuser") or the site's domain (e.g. "superuser.com"). User IDs are per-site, so pass the site of the thread the authorUserId came from. Blank or omitted defaults to "stackoverflow". Call stackexchange_list_sites to discover valid values.

tools.name: stackexchange_get_thread
tools.description: Fetch a Stack Exchange question and a page of answers, accepted first then by score, with Markdown bodies and attribution. Accepts a question ID, a full question URL, or a Share URL like "https://stackoverflow.com/q/11227809" or "https://stackoverflow.com/a/11227902". Use answersPage to continue and includeComments to read corrections and follow-up discussion.

questionIdOrUrl.description: Numeric question ID or a Stack Exchange question or answer URL (/questions/, /q/, or /a/). A URL supplies its site. If its host is unknown to Stack Exchange, the tool uses the explicit site when provided and otherwise reports invalid_site.

site.description: Stack Exchange site a numeric question ID belongs to — the apiSiteParameter (e.g. "stackoverflow", "unix") or the site's domain (e.g. "unix.stackexchange.com"). Defaults to "stackoverflow". Not needed with a URL, which names its own site: a site naming a different one is ignored, or used when the URL host is not a Stack Exchange site, and either way reported as siteConflict. Call stackexchange_list_sites to discover valid values.

maxAnswers.description: Votes page size (1–100, default 10). The linked answer and the first page’s accepted answer can add items beyond this size.

answersPage.description: Votes page to fetch, starting at 1. Keep maxAnswers fixed when paging.

includeComments.description: Fetch the requested comments page on the question and on batches of up to 100 returned answer IDs. An out-of-page answer from a long URL can add a separate comments request.

commentsPage.description: Comment page to fetch with includeComments, starting at 1. Keep the question URL, answersPage and maxAnswers fixed when paging comments.
